bq76952.measurement_method: Use BQ76952 thermistor mode and its programmed polynomial, then read the device temperature subcommands over I2C. Do not apply a host-side generic Beta equation to these readings. Raw ADC counts remain diagnostic inputs for open/short qualification only.
bq76952.selected_temperature_model: custom 18K-pullup temperature model fitted for the Shiheng MF52A103F3950(A1) R-T data
bq76952.cell_protection_channel_config_candidate: 0x27 per TS1, DCHG and CFETOFF; 18 kΩ pull-up + Custom Temperature Model + cell-temperature measurement/protection function, subject to per-pin config and readback verification
bq76952.calibration_source: Shiheng manufacturer R-T table for exact MPN MF52A103F3950(A1), processed with TI BQ769X2 Thermistor Coefficient Calculator / GPC workflow; TI TRM SLUUBY2B sections 6.4, 13.2.10 and temperature calibration section
bq76952.coefficient_status: not generated or returned by TI GPC; no coefficient bytes recorded or read back; no reference-bath calibration or open/short fault injection evidence
bq76952.existing_default_model_disposition: TI default 18K coefficients target Semitec 103-AT (10 kΩ, B25/85=3435 K). They must not be reused for this 3950 K sensor or treated as a host-firmware curve.

open_qualification: Generate and archive the TI GPC report from the exact manufacturer R-T table; verify every coefficient fits the BQ data-memory range and save configuration bytes separately from this schematic contract.
Read back TS1, DCHG, CFETOFF, TS2 and TS3 pin config, selected model coefficients, per-channel offsets, and protection limits before using temperature results.

Calibrate sensor channels against a traceable reference over the defined battery operating range; verify open/short detection, harness leakage, thermal lag, cell-to-bead contact, electrical insulation, strain relief and recovery behavior.

C13879 is a short-leaded bare bead rather than a cabled probe. If the pack build requires a sealed/cabled sensor, select and verify an exact 10 kΩ/B3950 probe MPN and its full R-T curve before changing the mechanical installation; keep the same board refs and pin maps.
